name: Camping 101: Alchemy
label: Quest
description: As an alchemist, you can learn to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Carolai Anise in Brill can teach you once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
intro: As an alchemist, you can learn to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Carolai Anise in Brill can teach you once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.
I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Mana Well. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
